{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABeg1r5Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIB5Xo", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 290, "title": "Show all four Graph Library actions directly, with Delete graph rightmost and confirmed", "body": "## Goal

Simplify the expanded graph's action row in Graph Library. Currently **Edit graph** and **Duplicate** are shown directly, while **Export JSON** and **Delete graph** are unnecessarily hidden under a separate **⋯ More** menu. With only four graph actions, display them all together.

**Approved layout (expanded accordion item only):**

```text
[Edit graph]  [Duplicate]  [Export JSON]                  [Delete graph]
```

- Remove the graph-detail **⋯ More** dropdown entirely.
- Show **Edit graph**, **Duplicate** and **Export JSON** directly in the existing detail action row, in that order.
- Show **Delete graph** directly as the **rightmost action**, visually separated from ordinary actions as space allows. Preserve a clear danger/destructive affordance without making it overly prominent.
- **Clicking Delete graph must require confirmation before deletion.** Reuse the existing confirmation behavior (`confirm(`Delete “<name>”? This cannot be undone.`)` or equivalent), including an unambiguous Cancel path. Never delete on the first click alone.
- Keep existing disablement and explanations when deletion is not allowed (e.g. referenced subgraphs or the last executable graph); do not bypass safeguards.
- Keep action behavior, selection target, auto-save flushing/conflict handling, draft recovery, duplication/export and Editor navigation unchanged.
- Make four visible controls fit/wrap cleanly on narrow screens. Delete stays **last** in visual and keyboard order; avoid clipping/overflow and keep accessible labels and focus states.
- Remove obsolete More markup/JS/CSS and adjust any tests that opened the menu.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The expanded graph shows Edit graph, Duplicate, Export JSON, and Delete graph without opening any menu.
- [ ] Delete graph is rightmost at normal desktop widths and last at narrower widths.
- [ ] Delete opens a confirmation before performing the action; Cancel preserves the graph.
- [ ] Existing cannot-delete rules and actionable reasons remain intact.
- [ ] Export, duplicate, edit, autosave and accordion expand/collapse continue to work.
- [ ] Relevant Graph Library browser/regression tests are updated and pass.
- [ ] No other Library UI/UX changes, new features, or additional confirmation screens.

## Context

The current single-column, one-expanded-item accordion comes from #285. Its only More options are Export JSON and Delete graph; hiding these actions adds unnecessary clicks.
